title: Cash home buyer buying as a principal (not an agent or broker)
jurisdiction: US federal + California (the rules this skill was first written against).
sources: E:/Francine & Eli/icm/knowledge/compliance/REQUIREMENTS.md rows D-13, D-14, D-17, D-18, D-25, D-27, D-28, D-07 (draft consolidation, not legal advice; lawyer review pending there)
notes: Items with severity warn are reported as WARN and fail only under --strict (launch). A business waives an item with --waive <id> when its own sign-off lifts the rule. business.json credentials.licensed = true turns the licence-claim rules off (the buyer holds a licence).

items.description: No licence claim on a principal buyer's page unless the buyer is licensed (credentials.licensed = true)
items.source: REQUIREMENTS D-13, D-18; DEFAULTS DEF-03 (no licence claim on Eli's pages unless the sheet says he is licensed)

items.description: The buyer does not describe itself as an agent, broker or Realtor (it buys as a principal)
items.source: REQUIREMENTS D-13 (unlicensed persons may not advertise as, or assume to act as, a broker or salesperson)

items.description: No advertising of buying notes or land contracts, or of lending, as a business (a broker/lender activity)
No deceptive offer claims: no 'full market value' promise and no guaranteed offer
items.source: REQUIREMENTS D-07, D-25 (a lowball presented as market value is a misrepresentation)

items.description: No foreclosure situation page or foreclosure-help copy while DEF-05 binds
items.source: DEFAULTS DEF-05 (lifts only by the lawyer's answers Q-35, Q-36, Q-39); waive with --waive CH-DEF05-001 once lifted

items.description: Fair-housing wording: no preference, limitation or steering by protected class in page copy
No unfilled placeholder such as {{HOURS}} visible on a published page
items.source: DEFAULTS DEF-03 / M-01 (placeholders until the owner supplies the value)

items.description: Disclosure pages exist: a privacy policy with request methods, and an accessibility statement
items.source: REQUIREMENTS P-26, DEFAULTS DEF-16. WARN while planning, FAIL under --strict at launch
